finding.name: structural_signature_execution_evidence_transport
finding.description: V7 Graph/RV forward admission pools completed sessions only by strategy/event/market-side signature. Current candidate expected edge, queue+target burden, target size, quote state and observation horizon are not inputs to evidence_for(), so positive fill/PnL history from an easier/richer policy state can authorize a materially harder/lower-edge current candidate with the same structural legs.

required_successor_contract: persist historical/current expected edge, target shares, queue/required flow, quote policy and observation horizon
do not route from structural-signature PnL alone
condition joint completion and partial-state economics on candidate execution state or use a fail-closed monotone transport rule
recompute current candidate EV from empirical full/partial/none states using current executable economics
require positive lower-bound fill-conditioned PnL under 1x/1.5x/2x costs before routing
